title: January road-blockade episode continued into February; some blockades remained near Cochabamba on 6 February

pre_month_start.note: EFE states Morales supporters began blocking highways on 22 January.

continuation_into_month.note: EFE on 6 February says some blockades remained near Cochabamba; this is the same January episode.

end_date.note: Exact physical end date remains unknown.

threshold.note: No crowd size reported; continuation does not establish >=50 participants.
